hypothesis: Naturalised plants add proportionally more new genera than new species to regional floras, relative to native genus and species counts.
pass_criterion: Across regions, (new genera / native genera) exceeds (new species / native species) by a factor of at least 1.5 in at least 75% of regions.
fail_criterion: The ratio is below 1.1, or the genus-level gain is not larger in a majority of regions.
interpretation: New genera are genera not present among natives of the region. This requires native counts per region, which a naturalised-only database does not supply.
no_dataset_reason: GloNAF (glonaf.org) lists naturalised taxa only. Native genus and species counts per region would need a second dataset, and the rules allow exactly one.
